visibility: Offline internal fixtures. No Run, model or money moves.
semantic_rejections: Caller ID differs from the funding Token; cross-field equality is checked in Go.
Usage scope/model/attempt/request/pricing differs from its confirmed gateway source.
Usage has an unrelated or self-related refund/correction ID, or one refund exceeds the confirmed call charge.
A DTO has a UI display log ID instead of a trusted persistent event reference.
A certified quote does not match the exact identity/model/config/output/time request, is expired, or does not prove a strict bound.
Run consumed/reserved/counters/time or concrete funds leave no positive budget for the proposed call.
A metadata_only record or missing production adapter is offered as executable admission.
